_note: Operation zones (docs/combined_arms.md 6.2, phase D1; OperationGen, ZoneDef.generate_operation). Distances along the axis of advance are metres from the friendly edge (or the sea); lateral ones from the axis's middle line. 'bands' end at their 'to_m'. Sites per zone ('sites') as hot zones generate them, scaled: outposts and checkpoints spread over the bands by 'band_share' (the crossing band gets the bridge's far-bank checkpoint and one outpost), the HQ, its comms site and QRF bases in the depth band. 'msr': where the main supply route runs; 'river': the band-2 river (ZoneWater's hint: 'water' is merged into the preset's water spec); 'crossings': where the steel truss route and the ford tracks cross (lateral metres apart). 'landmark_bands': the band each landmark kind goes in (ZoneModules.place_landmarks); 'depth_targets': the first of these the covered zones bring is the depth target, else 'depth_fallback' is added. 'terrain': the presets an operation takes from its covered zones, by region, the first that exists the fallback. All Proposed.
